items.hook: The term phi phenomenon is used in a narrow sense for an apparent motion that is observed if two nearby optical stimuli are presented in alternation with a relatively high frequency.
items.body: In contrast to beta movement, seen at lower frequencies, the stimuli themselves do not appear to move. One of those things you can't un-know.
